# master statistics (generated by pv8_master.py)

Rules used here and nowhere else:
- dR2 is computed per cell as R2 - mean(R2 under 500 block-order permutations).
- The table reports the median of the per-cell dR2 *and* the difference of
  the medians (R2 - R2null); the two differ and both are legitimate.
- loss is per cell BA(lambda=0) - BA(lambda=1); mean and median over cells.
- All BA(lambda) figures aggregate cells within subject first, then bootstrap
  over subjects (6,000 resamples).
